'''Grunts''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 20.
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 20.
*Spawned by [[Overseer|Overseers]].
*Spawned by [[Dreadnaut|Ancient Dreadnauts]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Grunts are highly Mobile Melee Group Combatants.

<!--*Like all [[Pure Parasites]], Grunts can summon [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them;-->
*Their Melee Attack inflicts AoE damage.
*Grunts can climb Blocks.
*Grunts can perform great leaps.
*Grunts will regularly perform short evasive dashes.
*Grunts can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Grunts can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Grunts can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerGrunt.png|Virulent=VirulentGrunt.png|Breacher=BreacherGrunt.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Grunts, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Grunts have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Grunts are also known as '''Flog''' in the Mod Files.
*Grunts are inspired by [https://www.halopedia.org/Abomination Flood Abominations], from Halo.
*A "grunt" is a slang term for a foot soldier or infantryman in the US Army, referring to the mob's nature as a highly mobile attacker and possibly relating to the soldier caste in colonial insects such as ants.
